items.title: A universally closed-on-points map over the base detects relative pseudo-coherence through its pushforward
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: Let i : X -> Y be a map of schemes over S, each locally of finite type over S, inducing a homeomorphism of X with a closed subset of Y; then E in D(O_X) is m-pseudo-coherent relative to S if and only if Ri_*E is so. The retained proof is written out: i is affine (Morphisms, lemma-homeomorphism-affine), reduce to affines S = Spec R, Y = Spec A, X = Spec B with A/rad -> B/rad surjective; choose algebra generators of B over A inside the radical with nilpotent powers and build the intermediate ring R[x_i, y_j]/(y_j^N) and the corresponding diagram of affine spaces over S; then walk the equivalence through the chapter's characterization of relative pseudo-coherence via pushforward to affine space (lemma-relative-pseudo-coherence-characterize) and the closed-immersion push-pull invariance (Derived Categories of Schemes, lemma-closed-push-pseudo-coherent) along the zigzag X -> T -> A^{n+m}_S and Y -> A^n_S. Retained author proof at lines 16957-16992.
